operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) There is established the President's Blue Ribbon Task Group on Nuclear Weapons Program Management. The Task Group shall consist of seven members qualified for service by reasons of experience and education. The President shall appoint three members and shall designate one of those members to act as chairman of the Task Group. The chairman and ranking minority members of the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and House of Representatives will each appoint one member.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) None of the members of the Task Group may be an employee of the Department of Defense or the Department of Energy.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 259681; common-crawl capture 2025-10-13T05:29:09Z; Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) The Task Group shall examine the procedures used by the Department of Defense and the Department of Energy in establishing requirements for, and in providing resources for, the research, development, testing, production, surveillance, and retirement of nuclear weapons and shall recommend any needed change in such procedures.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) The Task Group shall report to the President and the Committees on Armed Services of the Senate and the House of Representatives as specified in its charter but not later than July 15, 1985. The Task Group's report shall contain recommendations in the areas specified in Section 1632(e) of the Act.

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Members of the Task Group shall serve without compensation for their work on the Task Group.
